name: D2R PCVR
description: Diablo II: Resurrected in first-person VR with motion controls: native OpenXR through SteamVR or Virtual Desktop.

requires.note: His installer downloads and verifies it today (steamvr/install.py, LOADER_HASHES = the same two hashes); in the shared design the launcher does. The three file hashes are the ones measured for D2R VR's example; they are the same bytes.
His install.py cuts ReShade64.dll out of ReShade_Setup_6.8.0_Addon.exe (setup SHA-256 afe4c8f13048306307983b8b3d41d5bf00a86820440b0e57dea10950e1176445); the DLL's own hash was not measured.
his install adds Steam library shortcuts and sets the Steam launch options of app 2536520
SteamVR or Virtual Desktop's VDXR, chosen per start with XR_RUNTIME_JSON

files.note: loaded by name from the game folder (transport.cpp LoadLibraryW)
24 skies and the crosshair, byte for byte the same as D2R VR's
install.py also copies them beside D2R.exe
install.py writes the recommended ini; calibration lives in it
item and skill icons extracted from the player's own game (a cache; not redistributable)
potion models extracted from the player's own game
his installation record (backups chain); the importer reads it

external.note: LaunchOptions of app 2536520: the Python wrapper; restored by his uninstall. Not needed once the launcher starts the game itself
video settings (VSync, DLSS, AA...); shared with D2R VR's video page, never swapped
the helper folder: private Python, setup-backups, managed-installations.json

settings_hint: In VR: left grip + Frame Left B / Quest Left Y

needs.message: BodyWalk / FlatVR running next to D2R PCVR may fight for the headset.

preconditions.message: Use Steam > Exit: his setup edits Steam's configuration.
D2RLoader is not installed in this game folder.

x-unverified: /identity/markers (d2r_vr_icons, UTF-16, is in the 0.3.15 DLL and not in D2R VR's: checked on the installed build; the 0.3.13 string "Frame effects: preloaded shader compiler" is not in 0.3.15)
/identity/about_file (a proposal: his plugin does not write one yet)
/identity/plugin_id (today the same as D2R VR's; a unique id is proposed)
/files/*/src (the package layout under payload/ is a proposal: today install.py writes the files itself)
/files/5-7 seed (his installer builds the inis from d2r_vr.ini plus a table of forced values, not from files)
